rationale: C11 plausibly supplied the child’s two-stage operative template: first calling for a designated observance, then separately soliciting participation from a detailed hierarchy of state, municipal, federal, industry, labor, and organizational actors. The child adapts that unusually similar roster and sequence to a travel-promotion year. C14 is also close because it concerns a year-long observance, appropriate activities, and participation by States, Territories, and possessions, while C21 contains an earlier version of C11’s actor roster.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do proclaim the year 1960 as Visit the United States of America Year
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do call upon the people of our Nation to observe the week beginning October 5, 1958, as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week
shared_material.explanation: Both establish a named period of observance through the principal operative clause.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I request the appropriate officials of the Federal Government and of the several States, Territories, possessions, and municipalities of the United States to cooperate in the preparation for, and observance of, that year.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I also call upon the Governors of States, mayors of municipalities, Federal and other public officials ... to take part in this observance.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts the parent’s separate appeal to federal, state, and municipal officials to participate in the observance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I also urge business, labor, agricultural, educational, and civic groups ... to observe 1960 ... with exhibits, ceremonies, and other appropriate activities
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I also call upon ... leaders of industry and labor, and members of all concerned organizations to take part in this observance.
shared_material.explanation: Both follow the governmental appeal with participation language directed to industry, labor, and organized groups; the child expands the roster and specifies appropriate activities.
